assets.author: Claude
assets.tool: Claude (SVG rects written by a small generator, following the pixel rules of the starter heads, 2026-11-01)
assets.prompt: A sheet of 48x48 frames of a floating living staff for a top-down 32x32 pixel game, the cog head of the sandbox staff: an upright eight-tooth cog in the player colour with a dark axle hole round a gold hub, on a straight Wood shaft with a gold cap at its butt, the grip at (24, 27) of every frame. 16 columns, the staff pointing clockwise from right in 22.5 degree steps; 4 rows, the same staff with the head in each player colour ramp (blue, rose, green, purple). Light from the top-left, 1px dark outline. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md.
